scope: 0.10.1-claudegpt.25: PTY host protocol gaps for the native WPF shell, no protocol bump. (1) Observer attach: hello role 'observer' is welcomed beside the primary and never replaces it; advertised as services.observer=1 in the welcome and observer=1 in the host descriptor (checked before the hello, since older hosts treat any hello as a primary); welcome role/primary; observers get spawned/spawn-failed/exit, sessions.status and observer.primary events, views of their own keyed per connection, read-only (view-message ignored), spawn/write/dispose/shutdown ignored, services limited to sessions.list, observer.primary and transcripts list/info/times/title (else svc error 'forbidden'); replacing the primary closes only its views. (2) sessions.status events and sessions.list items carry a host-wide monotonically increasing revision; list returns { sessions, revision }. (3) claudeSessionId in welcome sessions, status events and list items, from the registry entry, else the latest hook session_id, else meta.launched/wsl. Node host (src/ptyhost) and Rust host (reframe-host, reframe-sessions); conformance tests for both. WPF Shell.Core attaches as an observer beside Electron when the descriptor advertises it, otherwise keeps the --take-over behaviour; applies the revision rule; uses claudeSessionId. Electron unchanged beyond tolerating the new fields.
